---
subtitle: "Prototype: the risk-free rate and the tangency portfolio"
---

```{r}
#| label: data
#| echo: false
#| cache: true
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyfinance)

# The Dow Jones 30 data of the Tidy Finance chapter "Modern portfolio theory"
symbols <- download_data(
  domain = "Index Constituents",
  index = "Dow Jones Industrial Average"
)

prices_daily <- download_data(
  domain = "Stock Prices",
  symbols = symbols$symbol,
  start_date = "2000-01-01",
  end_date = "2024-12-31"
)

prices_daily <- prices_daily |>
  group_by(symbol) |>
  mutate(n = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(n == max(n)) |>
  select(-n)

returns_monthly <- prices_daily |>
  mutate(date = floor_date(date, "month")) |>
  group_by(symbol, date) |>
  summarize(price = last(adjusted_close), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(ret = price / lag(price) - 1) |>
  drop_na(ret) |>
  select(-price)

assets <- returns_monthly |>
  group_by(symbol) |>
  summarize(mu = mean(ret), sigma = sd(ret))

sigma <- returns_monthly |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = symbol, values_from = ret) |>
  select(-date) |>
  cov()
```

```{r}
#| label: closed-form
#| echo: false
# Everything the slider changes follows in closed form from two vectors:
# tangency weights for a risk-free rate r are (a - r b) / (D - r C)
mu <- assets$mu
sigma_inv <- solve(sigma)
iota <- rep(1, length(mu))
a <- as.vector(sigma_inv %*% mu)
b <- as.vector(sigma_inv %*% iota)
C <- sum(b)
D <- sum(a)
E <- as.numeric(t(mu) %*% a)

frontier <- tibble(mu = seq(D / C - 0.02, max(mu) * 1.6, length.out = 200)) |>
  mutate(sigma = sqrt((C * mu^2 - 2 * D * mu + E) / (C * E - D^2)))

ojs_define(
  stocks = assets,
  frontier = frontier,
  ab = tibble(symbol = assets$symbol, a = a, b = b),
  consts = list(C = C, D = D, E = E)
)
```

## The risk-free rate and the tangency portfolio

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof rf = Inputs.range([0, 1.2], {step: 0.01, value: 0.2, label: "Risk-free rate, % per month"})
```

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="62%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
r = rf / 100
mvp_mu = consts.D / consts.C
denominator = consts.D - r * consts.C
tangency = ({
  mu: (consts.E - r * consts.D) / denominator,
  sigma: Math.sqrt(consts.E - 2 * r * consts.D + r * r * consts.C) / Math.abs(denominator)
})
slope = (tangency.mu - r) / tangency.sigma
sigma_max = 0.16
Plot.plot({
  width: 640,
  height: 440,
  x: {label: "Volatility (monthly)", domain: [0, sigma_max], tickFormat: "%"},
  y: {label: "Expected return (monthly)", domain: [-0.01, 0.04], tickFormat: "%"},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(transpose(frontier), {x: "sigma", y: "mu", stroke: "#1f2937", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(transpose(stocks), {x: "sigma", y: "mu", fill: "#9ca3af", r: 3}),
    Plot.text(transpose(stocks), {x: "sigma", y: "mu", text: "symbol", dx: 12, fontSize: 9, fill: "#6b7280"}),
    Plot.line([{sigma: 0, mu: r}, {sigma: sigma_max, mu: r + slope * sigma_max}],
              {x: "sigma", y: "mu", stroke: "#901A1E", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot([{sigma: 0, mu: r}], {x: "sigma", y: "mu", fill: "#901A1E", r: 5}),
    Plot.dot([tangency], {x: "sigma", y: "mu", fill: "#901A1E", r: 7}),
    Plot.text([tangency], {x: "sigma", y: "mu", text: d => "Tangency", dy: -14, fill: "#901A1E", fontWeight: "bold"})
  ]
})
```
:::
::: {.column width="38%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
weights = transpose(ab)
  .map(d => ({symbol: d.symbol, weight: (d.a - r * d.b) / denominator}))
  .sort((x, y) => y.weight - x.weight)
Plot.plot({
  width: 360,
  height: 440,
  marginLeft: 50,
  x: {label: "Tangency weight", tickFormat: "%", domain: [-1.5, 1.5]},
  y: {label: null, domain: weights.map(d => d.symbol)},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(weights, {x: "weight", y: "symbol", fill: d => d.weight > 0 ? "#901A1E" : "#9ca3af"}),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```
:::
::::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
denominator > 0
  ? md`Sharpe ratio of the tangency portfolio: **${(slope * Math.sqrt(12)).toFixed(2)}** (annualized). The risk-free rate is ${(rf * 12).toFixed(1)}% per year.`
  : md`**The risk-free rate exceeds the mean return of the minimum-variance portfolio** (${(mvp_mu * 100).toFixed(2)}% per month): the "tangency" portfolio lies on the inefficient lower branch of the frontier.`
```
